newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures settle narrowly mixed, bonds up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures settle narrowly mixed, bonds up.

text.p: May 6 - U.S. debt futures settled narrowly mixed, as T-bonds turned positive late. Traders said June bonds' ability to climb above 110-00 was constructive, but said the sideways pattern could continue for another day. Eurodollars closed lower after most set daily lows after the auction results.
